correctness.rationale: For either group table, 18 line and 36 marked point components have 108 flags and a connected 54-vertex graph, so arithmetic genus 55. Each 18x36 incidence B obeys the group-independent block Gram identity with eigenvalues 18, 6^15, 0^2; the Laplacian has the polynomial and tree count in RESULT.md. The exact local Smith checker reconstructs integer Laplacians from both multiplication tables, obtains the full valuations at 2 and 3 for TWO deleted roots, asserts valuation sums 31 and 36 equal to the independent spanning-tree order, and verifies all divisor-ordered factors. Proof of the 3-rank discrepancy uses Hom(G,F3) and S3 abelianization. Ordinary stable-curve semistable smoothing/Néron correspondence is standard, under explicitly stated unit-thickness hypotheses. Source: arXiv:0808.1529 Sections 1-2. No floating point, finite inference, or inaccessible certificate is used.

value.rationale: At the smallest nonabelian group order six, two geometrically realizable classical plane 3-nets have the same Laplacian spectrum and spanning-tree count yet distinct full integral degeneration component groups. The conceptual gap is detected by Hom(G,F3), while exact 3-primary invariant factors resolve the arithmetic difference. This is a motivated structural boundary between rational spectral data and integral Néron geometry, contrasted against a known order-four net coincidence, not a routine renaming or arbitrary subcase.
